title: Secure Cloud Operator Lesson 6: Identity and Access Management
objectives: Understand the importance of identity and access management in cloud security
Learn how to use AWS IAM roles and policies

mission_brief.situation: You are a cloud operator tasked with securing a new application deployed in the cloud
mission_brief.mission: Use AWS IAM to manage identity and access for your application
mission_brief.execution: Complete the lab steps to demonstrate your understanding

content.concept: Identity and Access Management in Cloud Security
content.walkthrough: Using AWS IAM Roles and Policies
checkpoints: Create an IAM role for your application
Attach policies to the IAM role

lab.setup: Create a new AWS IAM role and attach a policy
safety: Do not delete any IAM roles or policies

bug_injection.symptom: IAM role not attached to application

pass_conditions: IAM role created and attached to application

interrogation_questions: What is the importance of IAM roles in cloud security?
How do you attach policies to an IAM role?

prohibited: Deleting IAM roles or policies without authorization

resume_bullets: Created and attached IAM roles to applications
